intro: Archmage Malin is a senior human wizard stationed just outside the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind City's Mage Quarter. A former pupil of Archmage Trelane, Malin coordinates arcane affairs and field operatives dispatched to recover magical artifacts and rare reagents across the Eastern Kingdoms.

p: Standing sentinel beneath the towering spiral of the Wizard's Sanctum, Archmage Malin serves as a central point of contact for the arcane practitioners of Stormwind. He learned his craft under the tutelage of Archmage Trelane, a storied mage whose scattered legacy Malin now strives to protect. While younger acolytes study theory within the tower's swirling blue portals, Malin keeps his focus trained outward on matters across the realm that demand magical oversight.

Much of Malin's attention is directed north to the perilous ruins of the Arathi Highlands. To recover Archmage Trelane's lost possessions and secure delicate spell components, Malin dispatched his trusted associates, Skuerto and Apprentice Kryten, into the field. Coordinating these distant operations from the capital, Malin relies on capable Alliance travelers to carry instructions, supplies, and intelligence to his agents operating in hostile territory.
